title: Benefits Schedule Issued with a ShieldCare Plan
content:
The benefits a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan carries alongside the repair or
replacement of the covered item are those entered below. A money figure of 0.00 records a
benefit the plan does not carry at all.

| Benefit | Essential Parts and Labour | Accidental Damage Plus | Total Device Protection | Home Theatre Premium | Major Appliance Extended Service | Business Fleet Protection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| food spoiled by a covered appliance failure, most paid, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 350.00 | 0.00 |
| credit toward professional data recovery, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 |
| the failed item taken away when a replacement is delivered | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| a loan unit while the item is in for repair | no | no | yes | yes | no | yes |
| days the loan unit may be kept | 0 | 0 | 14 | 21 | 0 | 30 |
| a technician attends the address | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |

### Who may carry out covered work, and who pays to move the item

| Plan | Covered work may be carried out by | Sending the item to the depot and back is paid by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | in-store bench or authorised depot | the customer outbound, the retailer inbound |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | in-store bench or authorised depot | the retailer both ways |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | in-store bench, authorised depot or partner network | the retailer both ways |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | on-site technician or authorised depot | not applicable, work is on site |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | on-site technician for installed appliances, depot otherwise | not applicable, work is on site |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | on-site technician, depot or partner network | the retailer both ways |

### Notes

The food spoilage benefit is carried on ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service alone, at
350.00. The data recovery credit is carried on ShieldCare Total Device Protection at 150.00
and on ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection at 500.00. A loan unit is carried on three plans,
and the days it may be kept run 14, 21 and 30 on ShieldCare Total Device Protection,
ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium and ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection in turn; where no
loan unit is carried the days are entered as 0. On the two plans whose work is on site the
question of depot shipping does not arise.
